name: moxie-lang
description: Moxie (.mx): syntax highlighting, snippets, diagnostics from `moxie build`, completion, hover and go-to-definition.

moxie.path.description: The moxie compiler to run. May be an absolute path to a tree's ./moxie.

moxie.moxieRoot.description: MOXIEROOT for the compiler. Empty means the workspace folder.

moxie.buildOnSave.description: Run `moxie build` on save and report its errors as diagnostics.

moxie.buildFlags.description: Extra flags for the diagnostics build (e.g. -allow-closure-captures).

moxie.trace.description: Trace the language client's build invocations into the Moxie output channel.

commands.title: Moxie: Build the package and report diagnostics
